dimensions_m.note: width includes the A-pose arms of the rest pose; height is the helmet top (the new helmet is smaller than the old one, 1.861 m)

facing: Blender -Y = glTF/Godot +Z. In Godot the character faces +Z (rotate the model node 180 deg about Y if your controller treats -Z as forward).
origin: between the feet on the ground

upper_body_blend.note: Upper-body clips (rifle_aim, rifle_fire, rifle_reload, rifle_equip, pistol_*) are authored to be layered from bone "spine" upward over any locomotion clip. Use an AnimationTree Blend2 with a filter on spine, spine1, chest, neck, head, shoulder.*, upper_arm.*, forearm.*, hand.*, fingers.*, thumb.*, prop.R.

sockets.weapon: bone prop.R: add a BoneAttachment3D (bone_name "prop.R") to the Skeleton3D and add the weapon scene as its child with an IDENTITY transform. Both weapons are built in the prop.R bone frame (verified in Godot 4.7: rifle_aim puts the bore level and straight along the facing; the left hand lands on Grip_L within 0.08 m (wrist-to-grip-point, i.e. the palm is on it).

helmet_lamps.note: rest pose, model space; for a SpotLight follow bone "head" with a BoneAttachment3D and put the light at this offset from the head bone origin; point it along +Z (forward)
rest pose, model space; for a SpotLight follow bone "head" with a BoneAttachment3D and put the light at this offset from the head bone origin; point it along +Z (forward)

sockets.injector: child mesh "Injector" is skinned/parented to hand.R. Hide it except during the heal clip (events.injector_visible gives [show_s, hide_s]).

materials_notes.Suit: single PBR atlas for the whole suit (fabric, hard plates, metal rings, PLSS); roughness/metal from the ORM map
materials_notes.GlassVisor: gold reflective wrap-around visor (wraps ~112 deg each side, visible from 3/4 and side), alpha blend
materials_notes.EmitLamp: two helmet lamps (one material, both lamps)
materials_notes.EmitSuit: cyan chest status strip + small cyan status light on the backpack
materials_notes.Decals: RAO name tag, ISA patch, India flag (baked atlas)
materials_notes.InjectorMetal / InjectorOrange: the hidden Injector child mesh (heal clip)

notes: All clips are in place (no root motion); root stays at the origin; hips bob.
Cycles loop seamlessly (last frame equals first).
wake_up starts kneeling with hands on the floor and ends standing in the idle pose.
death ends face down; hold the last frame.

rifle_reload: the Mag node of the rifle should be reparented to hand.L between events.mag_out and events.mag_in if you want the cell to travel with the hand; otherwise hide Mag between mag_out and new_cell_grabbed and show it from new_cell_grabbed (simplest).
